task_completion.visual_evidence: The export interface or a file manager showing 'repeat_table.txt' being saved to the results directory.

task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or file preview showing 'clinical_report.txt' containing the CAG motif, 3 bp period, and a description of clinical significance.

integrity.visual_evidence: The file path '~/UGENE_Data/huntington/HTT_mRNA.gb' is visible in the UGENE project or open file dialog.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The sequence is the real human HTT mRNA (NCBI RefSeq NM_002111.8). The pathogenic CAG repeat is located in Exon 1. A period of 3 bp corresponds to the trinucleotide nature of the CAG repeat. Clinical significance involves the length of this repeat: <26 is normal, 27-35 is intermediate, 36-39 is reduced penetrance, and >=40 is full penetrance for Huntington's disease.
